<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8602_202409182" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">

        <lb n="95a7"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5283"><choice><reg>rnaM</reg><orig>°M</orig></choice> bshad</rs> 'di ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">tshig nyung dus gzhung gi don rgyas par <abbr>rtogs</abbr> par 'dod pa</rs> <abbr>dag gis</abbr> yang dang yang du bskul nas ¦ <choice><reg>sdom</reg><orig>d°oM</orig></choice> brtson daM pa mkhas pa'i <abbr>mchog grub</abbr> pa mnyes <abbr>pa'i</abbr> skyes bu <abbr>chen po</abbr> || snyan po dra gsung <abbr>phyogs</abbr> bcur <choice><orig><note type="gloss">'</note>phro</orig><reg>'phros</reg></choice> pa ¦ rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa'i <abbr>'phrin las</abbr> kyis <choice><reg>bskal</reg><orig>°skal</orig></choice> pa dang ldan pa <choice><reg>rnams</reg><orig>rnaMms</orig></choice> kyi <abbr>rnam par</abbr> 'dren pa | <choice><orig>mtshangs</orig><reg>mtshungs</reg></choice> pa med pa ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">yang dag <abbr>pa'i</abbr> dge ba'i <abbr>bshes gnyen</abbr> <abbr>smon lam</abbr></rs> gyi mtshan <lb n="95a8"/> daM pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos yang dag par len pa ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6029">shAkya'i dge slong <abbr>sangs rgyas</abbr> ston dpal bzang po</rs>s <choice><reg>sbyar</reg><orig>°byar</orig></choice> ba || <abbr>rdzogs so</abbr> || </seg></TEI>
